title: Agentic Workspace Evaluation Observation Input
description: Input accepted by the generated evaluation.observe operation.

evaluation_id.description: Registered evaluation id that will receive the observation.

criterion.description: Criterion id within the registered evaluation definition.

result.description: Observed result for the selected criterion.

evidence_refs.description: External evidence references, either as the CLI comma-separated string or an array of references.

burden.description: Collection or review burden for this observation.

context.description: Structured authority and comparison context, either as a JSON string from CLI transport or an object.

finding.description: Compact finding text derived from the observation.

recommended_action.description: Bounded next action recommended by the observer, when any.
